# Contributing

Thank you for helping to improve the Grow Codes SDK for Zipkin. This repository ships the same
API in **TypeScript, Rust, Go, Python and Java**. Please read this page and [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)
before you open a pull request.

By taking part you agree to follow our [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). Security problems are
reported privately, see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Ground rules

1. **API parity.** A public function, option, error code or behaviour change lands in all five
   languages in the same pull request, with tests in each. If one language cannot support it,
   document why in `docs/compatibility.md`.
2. **Generated files are not edited here.** Files that start with the line
   `Generated by sdk-kit … — do not edit` (the shared core, the category folders, the Docker
   harness, the workflows and this page) come from
   [sdk-kit](https://github.com/grow-codes-packages/sdk-kit). Change them there; the change reaches
   this repository with `sdk-kit sync`. Service code lives outside those folders.
3. **Tests and coverage.** Every change has unit tests. Coverage must stay at or above **90 % lines
   and 90 % branches** in every language (Go: 90 % statements). New public functions are also called
   in the Docker integration suite against a real Zipkin (`make test-docker`).
4. **No secrets in code, tests, logs or issues.** Use throwaway values; the test harness creates its
   own credentials.
5. **Small dependencies.** New runtime dependencies need a reason in the pull request and a licence
   from the allowlist in AGENTS.md.

## Development setup

You need Node.js 22.12+, Rust (stable, MSRV 1.88), Go 1.26+, Python 3.10+, JDK 17+ with Maven 3.9,
GNU Make and Docker with Compose v2.

```sh
make build          # build all five packages
make lint           # formatters, linters, type checks
make test           # unit tests
make coverage       # unit tests with the coverage gates
make test-docker    # integration tests against Zipkin in Docker (all languages)
make test-docker LANGS="go python"   # a subset
```

Every language folder has the same targets (`cd go && make test`).

## Commit messages and releases

We use [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) so that
[release-please](https://github.com/googleapis/release-please) can write the changelog and choose
the next version:

```
feat(python): add retry budget option
fix(go): map HTTP 412 to ErrConflict
docs: explain token renewal
```

Use the language folder as the scope (`typescript`, `rust`, `go`, `python`, `java`) when a change
touches one package only. A breaking change is marked with `!` (`feat!: …`) or a
`BREAKING CHANGE:` footer.

## Pull requests

- Keep pull requests focused; one topic per pull request.
- Update `docs/` and the README function overview when the public API changes.
- Make sure `make lint coverage` passes locally; CI runs the same targets plus the Docker suite.
- A maintainer reviews every pull request. We may ask for changes or close pull requests that do not
  fit the project.
